{\scriptsize\textit{Notes:} Joint fit of $(\alpha,\beta_{MKT})$ over the admissible domain ($\alpha\in[-2\%,2\%]$ per month, $\beta_{MKT}\in[-1,4]$, monthly gross benchmark return $\ge 0.08$). Outer vintage weights for $U_{v,H}$: $q_v=1$ weights each eligible ($n_v\ge 2$) vintage year equally (main specification), whereas $q_v=n_v$ weights each vintage proportionally to its fund count $n_v$. Bias against the true value and SD across replications ($\mathrm{RMSE}=\sqrt{\mathrm{Bias}^2+\mathrm{SD}^2}$). Panel~A: core designs of Table~\ref{tab:mc_core} ($c_v=0$). Panel~B: shared lognormal vintage shocks $W_v\sim\exp(\mathcal N(-\sigma_W^2/2,\sigma_W^2))$ common to all deals of vintage $v$ ($\sigma_W=0.306$ on Buyout shape, M4 $2c$; $\sigma_W=0.50$ on VC shape, matching empirical VC cross-vintage PV dispersion of 0.44 EW / 0.54 FW). Bound: share of draws on an active constraint of $\Theta$ (included in bias and SD; in VC $\sigma_W=0.50$ at $H=0$, nearly all boundary hits are $\alpha=+2\%$: 40.0\% L2 VYP, 24.8\% $U_{v,0}$ $q_v=1$, 42.8\% $q_v=n_v$). Joint inference calibration for $U_{v,H}$ ($q_v=1$): in the Panel~A cores at $H=0$, the nominal 5\% fixed-$b$ test of $\alpha=0$ rejects in 12.1\% (Buyout) and 10.9\% (VC) of tested draws; at 30 years conditional rejection collapses to 0.4\%/0.5\% for $\alpha$ and 1.1\%/0.3\% for $\beta$ (same-sample SE/SD 1.342/1.330 vs.\ 0.915/0.933 against all-draw SD). In Panel~B, $H=15$ yr cuts $U_{v,H}$ ($q_v=1$) $\alpha=0$ rejection from 28.1\% to 6.0\% (Buyout $2c$) and from 31.2\% to 6.4\% (VC $\sigma_W=0.50$). Boundary rates across all 13 core and margin designs appear in Appendix Table~\ref{tab:mc_alpha_beta_bounds}. Monte Carlo SE of $\hat\beta$ bias: 0.003--0.020 (Panel~A), 0.016--0.041 (Panel~B).}
